verses.text: A Song of the Ascents. Come, bless YHWH, all servants of YHWH, those standing in the house of YHWH by night!

segments.text: A Song of the Ascents. Come, bless YHWH, all servants of YHWH, those standing in the house of YHWH by night!

verses.text: Lift up your⁺ hands to the holy place, and bless YHWH!

segments.text: Lift up your⁺ hands to the holy place, and bless YHWH!

verses.text: May YHWH bless you from Zion, Maker of heavens and earth!

segments.text: May YHWH bless you from Zion, Maker of heavens and earth!
